# 高温材料与防护

_High-Temperature Materials & Protection_

热端材料及其表面防护需要适应高温和复杂环境。NASA 的公开资料可作为认识热障/环境障涂层、陶瓷基复合材料等方向的入口。

_Hot-section materials and their protective systems must withstand high temperatures and demanding environments. NASA references introduce thermal and environmental barrier coatings and ceramic-matrix composites._

## 阅读要点 / Reading Notes

- 记录材料体系、工作环境和失效模式，避免只列材料名称。

_Record the material system, environment and failure mode rather than listing material names alone._

- 把基体、涂层与冷却作为整体阅读，关注界面和热循环。

_Read substrates, coatings and cooling together, with attention to interfaces and thermal cycling._

- 区分材料试样结果、部件试验与发动机应用证据。

_Distinguish coupon results, component tests and demonstrated engine applications._
